screening_evidence.research_object: Automatic generation control and frequency stability in a single-area thermal-hydro-gas multi-source electric power system.
screening_evidence.methods: Proposes a cascade fractional-order FOID-FOPTID controller, tunes its parameters with the wild horse optimization algorithm, compares it with PID/TID and other controllers, evaluates single and hybrid energy-storage devices, and tests parameter perturbations.
screening_evidence.contribution: Reports an optimized controller and comparative frequency-response simulations, with CES-RFB identified as the strongest hybrid storage option in the abstract-level evidence.
screening_evidence.network_evidence: The abstract centers on a single-area power-system control model and controller tuning; it does not present network topology, dynamics on networks, or a transferable network-science method as the main contribution.
screening_evidence.caveat: Research article and abstract are visible after normal verification, but v9 screening should use the online-first date rather than the September issue month.

screening_evidence.research_object: Synchronization and anti-synchronization in multi-layer coupled reaction-diffusion neural networks under bidirectional deception attacks.
screening_evidence.methods: Introduces signed topology and a signed Laplacian, uses orthogonal transformations to unify synchronization objectives, and proposes a resilient adaptive event-triggered primary-auxiliary control scheme using current and historical samples; Lyapunov-Krasovskii analysis and comparative simulations provide sufficient criteria and validation.
screening_evidence.contribution: Combines multilayer cooperative-competitive topology, reaction-diffusion and time-varying delays with dual-channel attack resilience, while reducing triggering and communication burden.
screening_evidence.network_evidence: The abstract explicitly makes multilayer network topology, signed inter-layer interactions, and dynamics on coupled networks central to the model and method; it is a strong v9 network-science candidate subject to the fixed screening taxonomy.
screening_evidence.caveat: Research article and complete abstract are visible after session reuse, but its effective v9 date is June 2, 2026 rather than the September issue label.
